balls.text: the audacity! Full and wide outside off but Gaikwad goes forward, gets low, and plays a flick-sweep over square leg for six! Unbeaten on 88, an innings that CSK desperately needed, and CSK finish on 156 for 6
full just outside off. Just goes for a leg-side slog. Ball rolls away to deep midwicket and that's 150 for CSK!
that's pinned him on his boot but impact outside off stump. Ruturaj tried to go across and play over square leg, but Bumrah got that spot on
excellent timing. Full just outside off. Gaikwad presses forward, gets down on one knee, and hits a beautiful drive over cover. Teases the outfielders en route to the boundary.

holes out. But Bravo has played an excellent cameo. Bumrah goes for the length ball that angles in from wide of the crease. Bravo can't make room, looks to loft it over cover, but slices it to the fielder inside the circle
back of a length around off stump. Bravo comes down the wicket and tries to flat-bat a shot over Bumrah's head. Mistimed, and it rolls away to long off. Gaikwad pushes Bravo to complete the second
full ball, slower all, wide ball. Bravo offers no shot

24 off the over! And CSK have crossed 141. How about that? Like Milne's last ball of the spell, Boult's goes for a six too. Tries a yorker around leg stump, overpitches it, and the full toss has been clipped off his pads for six over cow corner. For a brief second it looked like Gaikwad may be caught out in the deep, but the ball just travelled.
yorker length almost. On middle and off. Digs it away to deep extra cover for one
that deserved to be put away. Short ball, slower ball, and Bravo was almost expecting that length. Stays in his crease, stands tall, and pulls it over deep midwicket for another half-a-dozen
bottom hand gets the elevation and the distance! In the slot, on middle stump. Bravo uses his wrists to get the bat under the ball, and sends it soaring over the off side fence
full on middle and leg. Plays an inside out drive to deep extra cover for one
misses the yorker on leg stump by around an inch, but that's good enough for Gaikwad. Plays a "sweep-like" shot off his toes, and hits it square enough to beat fine leg!

classic Bravo! Back of a length outside off with the pace taken off. Bravo skips down, and slices an inside-out flayed shot over wide long off for six. Milne still finishes with a very respectable 2-21 in his four. But that six made it a good over for CSK.
slower ball, good length, fairly wide. Throws his hands at it to slap a cut to deep point
good length just outside off. Slower ball, angling in with the arm. Guides a cut to short third man
full just outside off. Comes down the ground and mistimes a sloggy shot down to long on
fullish, just outside off. Gaikwad makes room to cut, but doesn't get the timing he desired. Cut to point although he wanted to pierce the point-short third man gap
full on middle. Bravo stays on the back foot and flicks it to long on down the ground
another yorker attempted. Angles in as a low full toss. He flicks it smartly off his pads to the gap at deep midwicket. Two fielders converge to cut the boundary off
yorker attempted. Ends up as a low full toss angling into off. Flicked to square leg

around the stumps. Full ball outside off. Jadeja clears the front leg and tries to hit a big shot over Bumrah's head but he's sliced it since Bumrah had taken the pace off. Pollard at long off gets under it, and pockets a catch with ease. An important 26 from Jadeja given the innings' situation when he walked in
cuts this length ball away to point
full and wide. And it's the slower ball too but Gaikwad's timing is so on point. Adjusted his shot late to meet the ball a microsecond later, and lifted it over long off!
Gaikwad trying to be creative but can't pull it off. It's a wide yorker, and Gaikwad looks to scoop one over the slip cordon by stretching his hands out. No connection
good length on off. Comes down the wicket and beautifully times a punch down to long off. Eleven off the over
pumped! Uses his arm strength to smack a shot over the umpire to long on for four. Good length, wide outside off, flat-batted down the ground
slower ball, full on off and middle. Gaikwad walks across exposing all stumps before trying to play a shot at fine leg. But he's deceived by the pace, and it's gone down leg side. But wide not given!
back of a length, wider outside off. Stands tall and thumps a pull in front of square! Wide long on can't cut it off and that's his sixth IPL fifty! What a future star.
back of a length, on leg stump. Jadeja skips down the wicket, and cuts it to point. No run
full ball, just outside off. Sticks the bat out and taps it towards point
good length, just outside off stump. Flays a shot down to long on for a single. Minimal footwork. Time out again
fullish, just outside leg stump. Stays on the back foot and looks to flick behind square. Hits the pad and rolls away to short fine leg
full on leg stump. Looks to flick it through midwicket, but it's the googly that turns across. Leading edge to point
full, on middle. He gets onto the back foot, and fends it towards the leg side
awkwardly punched down the ground to wide long on where Boult is present. Half-tracker on leg turning across Jadeja with some extra bounce
overpitched, lands outside leg and turns in. Looks to sweep, but misses. Hits the pad, and a gentle lbw enquiry swiftly turned down
not full pace. Fullish outside off, and tapped towards point. Surya misfields while trying to stop the single, which otherwise could've been a run-out chance
good length on middle, but it angles down the leg side. Jadeja saw the ball's direction and offered no shot
good length, just outside off. Sticks the bat out and plays a cut to backward point
another full slower ball. Comfortably flicked in front of square, past midwicket. Deep backward square leg has to run around the boundary perimeter to cut the boundary off
yorker attempted, nearly successful. Ends up just at Jadeja's toes, and he craftily flicks it behind square around fine leg for two fielders to run after
slower ball. Full just outside off. Jadeja gently drives to Kishan manning the cover region
full outside off but angling into off. He skips down the wicket to lift it over cover. But edged past the vacant slip cordon to third man
full on off and sliding into middle. Swept to deep midwicket, where Krunal cleans up. Jadeja wants two, but Gaikwad is not interested. Fifty partnership
short and wide. Turning further away. Tries to cut, mistimed
good length, on middle. Skips onto the leg side to make room, and the cuts it behind square for four to point! Gaikwad in his 40s now.
full outside off. He stretches out, and gets the sweep behind on the leg side. Deep backward square leg has to dive, and successfully stops the four
flatter. Length ball on middle. Rocks back and flat-bats a pull to long on
full, outside leg stump. Turning into leg. Clipped off his pads to square leg
cheeky! Confidently plays the reverse sweep. Full, just outside off. Gets into position early, and he plays it in such a way that it lobs over the infield. Runs away to the third-man boundary
fullish, outside leg stump. Tucked to fine leg's right. Most expensive over of the innings so far
played fine! Length ball angling across from Jadeja. He sticks the bat out late, and it gets an edge that takes the ball just past de Kock's hands!
good length, outside leg stump. Looks to flick from near his hips. Misses, collects the wide
Krunal drops his length next ball. Good length outside off. Walks down the pitch to punch towards long off
up and over! Full on middle. He skips down the ground, stays outside the line of the ball, and lofts it gently over Krunal for six
good length on middle, from around the stumps. He skips backwards, and cuts it through the infield to the sweeper fielder on the off side
good length, outside leg. Turning into leg and middle. Flicked off the back foot to the leg side
fullish on off. Turning away. Cut square to backward point
good length on leg stump. Turning in. Carefully flicked in front of square on the leg side. Has to be careful since leg slip is in play too
full outside off. Turning away, and he presses forward to nudge a drive to long off
full just outside off. Reverse sweep attempted, but struck only to short third man
length ball, drags the length totally. Pulled along the ground to deep midwicket
punches this back, good work by Krunal in moving swiftly to his right to stop
tossed up on middle and leg, Jadeja defends this into the legside
steps out and tucks it into the leg side
slips this down leg, the keeper can't get around in time and lets it through for two leg byes
drifting into middle and leg, tucked towards midwicket
top-edges a sweep that bounces well short of the man running around at fine leg
tucks it to deep square
dropped! QDK puts down a touch chance. Gaikwad went for a cut, this wasn't all that short really. It zipped through too.
gets a thick inside edge onto the pad as he drives
punched to long-on
tucks it into the gap at square leg, they run the second one hard and make it comfortably
rocks back and cuts to deep point
lunges forward and stabs it away
slower and fuller outside off, driven straight to cover
gets a thick inside edge onto the pad as he pushes forward
width and he slaps this down to deep point
beaten as he attempts to push at that with an angled bat
punches to sweeper cover
slips this down leg, wide called
pushed to point for a single
dug in short outside off, Jadeja lets this pass
that should hurt! Jadeja cops a blow on the glove as this short ball keeps coming back into him.
sways out of the way of this short ball outside off
gets half-forward and defends into the off side
driven nicely past the diving point fielder, couple of runs into the kitty
starts off with a yorker, squeezed to third man

he's hit this beautifully but has picked out the lone man at deep square! It came to Boult faster than he expected but he manages to hang on. Dhoni walks off in disbelief! This was short, Dhoni swiveled nice and early and picked the bones out of this pull.
bunts it down to third man
scorching drive, straight to extra cover
overpitched and put away! Nice, delicious half-volley on the pads and he put that away without much fuss. Once he beat midwicket, it sped to the boundary
squirted to midwicket for a quick single
off the pad, but the angle would've taken it down leg. This was full and angling in, Dhoni was beaten for pace as he looked to flick it square
nearly chopped on! Looking to ease it through the off side but this nipped in to roll towards the stumps off an inside edge.
steps out and looks to swing downtown, gets a thick edge to Abu Dhabi! I mean, he looked to hit it to long-off but found third man.  Swings Sharjah, finds Abu Dhabi
gets well forward and steers this gently to point
helps this pull along to fine leg, picked the length early that time
works it gently towards square leg as they take a quick single
squared up by the length but manages to push it wide of covers for a quick single
pushes this to backward point
beaten as he attempts a loose drive to a length ball that nips away
plays inside the line as he lets this go
where has that gone? Into the gap to beat Boult at fine leg. This was short and angling in, Gaikwad went for the pull, got a top-edge but into the area where there was no fielder.
full and tailing in, squirted off a thick inside edge to mid-on
nip-backer from outside off on a length, solidly defended

got him! Raina was never comfortable! This was full and swinging away, Raina backed away anticipating the short ball, threw his bat at that only for it to break into two pieces, the slice lobbed straight to point. Raina wouldn't want to look at this innings, ever.  A good chunk of wood came off as Raina swung at that.
hops back as he's hustled for pace, tucked to short fine.
has a wild swing at this, gets a top-edge that sails into the third man boundary. Streaky but that'll do for now
length and moving away from outside off, play and a miss from Raina as he looks to have a go at this one. Pulled out at the last moment.
another short ball on middle, this one whizzes past Raina's ears as he ducks under it
there comes a short ball into his ribs, Raina rises with the bounce and fends it away

Rayudu is on the floor! This one was banged in short, he thought it'll comfortably pass over but it nipped back in, kept low and smacked his elbow. Rayudu is in serious pain. The left elbow has swollen and the physio is out with his magic spray.
superb stop at square leg, Tiwary on fire! Throws himself to his left to stop this short-arm jab
snorter! Goes short from wide of the crease at close to 140kph, it was anglging in and Rayudu somehow manages to get out of the way

he has toe-ended this attempted slap straight to cover point! Milne goes short of length, Moeen has width to work with but has no timing. Tiwary takes a good catch diving low to his right. Super Kings rocked early
nips back in to hit him high on the pad as he looks to tuck it into the leg side
drives but gets a thick outside edge that flies one bounce to third man
full and swinging away from off stump, Moeen lets this pass
got him! Faf has a go at this because he has a hint of width, but he ends up slicing it straight to short third man. Boult roar, Mumbai strike early.
nice and full on middle and leg, bunted gently into the off side
slants one across a touch full on off, Faf defends from the crease
has he got him? Massive appeal for lbw as he gets it to swing back into middle and leg, the ball deflects off the pad to the off side. Gaikwad was falling over. Impact outside leg, missing leg.
on target straightaway as he gets this full delivery to bend back into middle, defended back
slower ball, full outside leg stump. Clipped to midwicket where Raina misfields. CSK beat Mumbai Indians by 20 runs!
yorker length, on off. Tries to dig it out, and ends up inside-edging it onto his pads
slower ball, full outside off stump. Chahar goes deep before bringing out the slog sweep. Struck well, but straight to the safe Raina at short midwicket!
full and wide. Tiwary reaches out and nudges it to mid off. Fifty for Tiwary which the crowd acknowledges, but he himself does not acknowledge it

boundary rider at deep midwicket takes a simple one. Fullish, outside off and angling in. Milne swings the bat and it's got a decent connection. But Gowtham is a tall man on the boundary line, and pockets that comfortably
slower ball, full and wide outside off. Digs it away, and the ball is squirted down to deep point for one
full outside off stump. Milne gives his everything trying to slog a six over long on. But he's played that shot inside the ball's line. Through to Dhoni and Mumbai need 24 off six
good length delivery, but a wider ball outside off. Jagging further away as Milne can't slap a cut away. Umpire says that's one extra
back of a length, very wide outside off. Wayward release. Wide given - this time umpire Illingworth is 100% correct

back of a length on middle, and going just down the leg side as Milne looks to pull. Misses, goes past his armpits to the keeper. Wide not given! Bold from umpire Illingworth, who believes that would've hit Milne had he not moved
full and wide outside off. Milne uses his long levers to get a proper golf swing into this shot. Soars over long off, despite being a knuckleball!
full and wide outside off. Milne walks across to the off side to ramp it over short fine leg. But mistimed to the on side
full outside off. He reaches out again and clubs a shot down the ground to long off for one
full and wide outside off. Tiwary is a tall man and he reaches out to cream a drive through the covers!
sliced over cover to the fielder in the deep where Gowtham is fielding as a sub for Rayudu. Full outside off and angling away
struck down the ground to long on

a rare Dhoni drop! Confusion between him and Bravo at short fine leg. This was full on middle, and Tiwary tries to play a cute paddle over short fine leg. However the ball pops right up in the air, and both experienced men try to take the catch. Dhoni stretches out too, but just beyond his gloves. May have been distracted by Bravo. Can't blame anyone. But weird for two experienced men to do that
attempts the wide yorker. Tiwary thought this would be full on middle/leg because he was walking across to play a paddle. However, he has to adjust, and guides this wide yorker to third man late
good length on off. Angling further away. Stays on the back foot and uses all that power he has to flat-bat a four down the ground! Long off was there on the boundary, but this was hit too straight

full on middle and he clears the front leg to try and hoick a shot over midwicket. Can't get bat on ball. Hits the pad and rolls away to the leg side. Chahar wobbles on the followthrough, and has a small chat with Dhoni on the way back to his mark
fullish, outside off stump. Flays a shot down the ground to long off for one
good length, just outside off stump. Defended back to the bowler
full on off, and he shovels a mistimed shot over the umpire to long on
good length ball angling in. Tries to pull a six after swiveling, but mistimed to deep backward square instead
full ball on off. Mistimed drive back to Hazlewood. Milne will never find facing Hazlewood easy
good length, outside off. Cut to deep point
yorker attempted, nearly successful. Lands just in front of off, and dug back to Bravo. Just seven off it
full and wide outside off stump. Driven towards cover for a single
slower ball, wide outside off stump. No shot offered
full ball on middle. But Milne comes down the track, and ends up yorking himself. Dug out, and the ball dribbles down to mid on
overpitched, just outside off. Brings the bat down with the open face to guide a drive to deep point
bunted over the non-striker to long off but only for two. Good length ball angling across and mistimed with a flat-batted shot
slower ball to start off. Full just outside off. Driven to long off for a single
full on leg stump. Tucked off his pads to midwicket. Nobody inside the circle and therefore it's an easy second run on offer.
full outside off stump. Turning in, and driven to long off for a single

length ball on middle, and clipped to midwicket. Krunal wants one right away, but there was no run there. Bravo picks up and throws it to Dhoni while Krunal looks to turn and get back. Too slow to do that, Dhoni is standing right on top of the stumps, and the bails have been whipped off in a flash. They've gone upstairs for confirmation but Pandya isn't waiting. He's on his way out!
full on off and angling into leg. Punched off the back foot but very nearly carries to midwicket!
full on middle and leg. Swiped fine to the fielder at fine leg
around the stumps. Full on off stump. Nudged off the front foot to wide long on
good length, on middle. Mistimed pull along the ground to midwicket
full on off and he clatters a drive to long off for just one. The required run-rate gets closer to 11.
full on middle and leg. Flicked to deep backward square leg for a single
good length on leg stump. Fended off the back foot
full ball on middle, and pushed to mid off for a single

trapped first ball! And Hazlewood gets Pollard with a full ball that skids in while staying low. Full on off, zipping in, hits him low on the back leg with the bat too slow to get down. Pollard reviews, which is of course his right, but this looks plumb. Ball-tracking confirms that's crashing into middle stump. Big wicket, Hazlewood makes a strong return in his second spell.
full just outside off. Pushed to cover, who is on the circle line. Comfortable single taken
full on middle. Looks to drive, but inside edge to the on side
full outside off stump. Pushed to cover's left, but Raina dives to stop the run
full on off stump. Presses forward, taps it to mid off, and calls early for the single
full on off stump. Bit of angle across the left-hander. Mistimes a drive to the sweeper fielder on the off side
full on off stump, and he flicks it off his pads to deep backward square leg for one
dabs this full ball down the ground for four
slower ball goes down the leg side with Pollard offering no shot
full outside off stump. Shoulders his arms
fullish, just outside off stump. Defended off the front foot
tries a dipping yorker outside off. Ends up as a full toss, and driven to long off
full just outside off. Just leans into a drive, and places the shot absolutely perfectly! Between Raina at short cover and the fielder at mid off. #PlacementOnFleek
full outside off, and he drives it through the offside. Stopped by cover inside the circle
full on off. Big stride forward and defended away. Thirteen off Jadeja's over
full on off. Big stride forward, picks it from near his toes, and hits it over long on for six! Nearly hits the car on display near the boundary
full on middle. Swiped down the ground to long on
around the stumps. Full on off stump, and flicked to deep midwicket
tucked off his pads to the leg side
and thumped first ball! Fullish outside off, turning in, and pumped past the non-striker to long on
poor ball and that has been spanked through the covers. No sweeper either so there was just one result possible.
walks out of the crease and defends this into the leg side
beauty! This is a cracker that opens up Pollard. Another lovely delivery that lands on the seam and moves away to square him up.
length ball outside off, Pollard lets this go

he's picked out cover where Raina makes no mistake! Bravo once again goes full and just outside Kishan's reach, this is a slower one, mind you, so he has to force the pace. Kishan tries to go over the infield but fails to do so and Chennai have a massive wicket.
off a thick inside edge, races away to the fine leg boundary. This was a lovely offcutter from DJ Bravo
whips this flatter one to deep square
pushed through quicker and fired in, Tiwary who makes room ends up punching it wide of cover
swept from way outside off, down to wide long-on where Chahar cuts that off
turns this gently into the leg side, behind square. Dhoni hares back to stop that
steps out and hits it flat on the bounce to long-on
backs away to go inside-out over cover, gets a thick inside edge to long-on
beaten as this ball awkwardly rises on him. Kishan was cramped for room too as he tried to run that down
tucks this down towards backward square leg
lovely drive but straight to Gowtham at sweeper cover
dug in short, helps the pull one bounce to fine leg
gets this to thud high on Tiwary's bat, Thakur bending his back and bowling with pace
beaten as he wafts at this away-going length ball
driven firmly to sweeper cover
gets to the pitch as he eases it with the spin to long-off
tucks this down to fine leg as they jog the single
nicely tossed up and drifting into middle, he lunges forward and blocks
drifts in and skids this through, Tiwary defends to mid-off
driven down to long-off
bullet drive that beats mid-off! By no means a half-volley but Tiwary met this as close as he could and punched that away into the gap apst the diving Hazlewood
gets half-forward and defends into the off side

no timing and he's gone!  Shardul gets into the thick of things, it's that man Faf with a top catch. Looks to loft him down the ground on the up but the ball stops on him and goes off the bottom part of the bat, Faf running back and across from mid-off takes a superb catch.
stands tall and defends this length delivery into the covers
touch full as he bowls a cross-seam delivery, pushed to mid-off for a quick single
whips this into the leg side, the midwicket fielder half-stops it for mid-on to retrieve

bowled him with a slower ball! Anmol looks to mow this leg side but is deceived by the knuckleball, early into the stroke and the off-stump goes for a toss. Chahar roars, Chennai Super Kings fan roar.
through with the pull even before the ball arrived, hit on the shoulder
goes a touch full outside off, punched straight to mid-off
beaten as he looks to drive on the up. Chahar slowed this down and bowled it on a length.
drilled to mid-off, who parries it to mid-on. Lovely from Faf
leading edge but safe, rolls towards point. Hint of away movement from D Chahar
punched into the gap between cover and point. Easily the best shot of the over! By no means a half-volley, all hands and timing from Anmol. He's up and running.
delightful pick up shot for six! Drifts into middle and leg on a length, and he whips this to clear the ropes at fine leg. Strong bottom hands
beaten as he slashes at this length ball outside off. Wasn't there for the cut, didn't have the room either.
lovely pick up shot! Picked it off a length and whipped it behind square to beat fine leg.
length ball on the stumps, works it to mid-on. Tight line, good bowling
nips away from off as Anmol plays with an angled bat to gully
solid push into the off side
looks to pull but he's beaten for pace, the top-edge lobs where gully would be. Streaky single
whips this straight to mid-on, good work by DJ Bravo
full and angling in, flicked to fine leg. It was perhaps an attempted yorker.

big appeal for lbw, massive appeal infact. Not given by Illingworth but MSD reviews immediately. Looks very close, I think he's in trouble. This is bowled full on middle and off, the ball bends back in a touch to beat the inside edge as well as he tries to work it through the leg side. Ball tracking comes back to show this would've crashed into the stumps. Chahar knew it straightaway, he didn't even bother turning back until he passed de Kock.
strong bottom hands, steely wrists and fine timing - what a cocktail! Not too full but QDK gets forward and then brings his wrists to play to pick that on-drive past mid-on. So delightful
length on middle and leg, tickled nicely to fine leg
right in his swinging arc, de Kock clears his front leg and clobbers him over mid-off.
through Gaikwad's hands at midwicket! This was a full-blooded pull, Gaikwad leapt high but this one bursts through for a couple
walks across and helps him along into the leg side to beat fine leg. Brave shot that. Just used the pace so very well
steered down to third man, Anmolpreet is off the mark
hits the deck on a length around off-stump, Anmol defends back hurriedly
turns it straight to midwicket. Tight first over
beaten as he looks to walk across and flay this through the covers
gets this to jag away but from outside leg, De Kock whips this into the gap between midwicket and square leg
gets this to bend back in from outside off, pushed straight to mid-off
punches straight to cover
slants one full across QDK, not much movement that time, solidly defended
